Subject: VoC pairing request — NexaTel edge-ML pilot reference

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

Late-stage deal update: NexaTel (regional telco in APAC) is set to sign pending a short reference call. Use case is edge-hosted ML inference for base station video analytics (tight latency window, high availability). Procurement has asked for a peer who has run a similar pilot and can speak to performance/operational lessons (quantization tradeoffs, remote deployment, rollback).

Requirements: 30-min customer-to-customer call next week (UTC+8 preferred), someone who can speak to:
- deployment topology (on-site vs colo),
- latency numbers under 50ms 95th,
- incident/rollback story and automation for KV cache warmups.

Questions:
1) Who do we have that fits this telco/edge angle and is comfortable talking to procurement?
2) Any known restrictions (NDA / reference policies) we should surface?

Attaching a one-pager and the draft POC SOW we want to share. I can take the intro and schedule — looking for recommended advocate(s).

Thanks,
Ben

Suggested advocates:

Ben — happy to help.

I ran the GridWave engagement earlier this year — they did edge inferencing with 8-bit quantized weights and we hit ~42ms 95th after batching tweaks; they also had a hot-warm cache strategy to cut cold-start penalties. Ops lead: Daniel Kim (daniel.kim@gridwave.io). He’s generally open to 30-min calls and can be frank about the hit-and-fix items (network MTU tuning, KV cache priming).

I’ll intro Daniel and Priya at TeleEdge, but quick ask: can you confirm the exact call window (UTC+8 morning/afternoon) and whether NexaTel wants an NDA reference waiver? If procurement insists on a legal text I’ll loop Legal.

Marissa
